oracle.derivation: ngspice's RTL inverter example. Only the transient plot is replaced; the other plots stay ngspice-44.2 values, which Xyce 7.10.0 confirms within 0.943x their tolerance. Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 34.2x its tolerance off it.
